modeIntro.title: One product scan, two clear workflows.
modeIntro.body: Use Shopper mode when you are deciding what to buy: upload a product screenshot and ReviewIntel checks public review signals, repeated complaints, value, rating clues, and AI-like review patterns before giving a BUY, CONSIDER, or AVOID verdict. Use Seller mode when you manage a product: scan reviews to find complaint clusters, keyword themes, trust gaps, listing improvements, and next actions for product quality, support, ads, and conversion.

steps.uploadDetail: Reviews, TXT, CSV, or quick screenshots.
steps.scanDetail: Trust, complaints, value, keywords, and patterns.
steps.answerDetail: Shopper verdict or Seller Pro report.

Results.trustQuestion: Do these reviews prove buyers can trust this product?
Results.trustBlockerHeading: Here is what is stopping more buyers from trusting this product.

signalClauses.lexical: reuse a small set of words

honestyFrames: This checks review text for patterns only — it can't prove who wrote a review.
It's a text-pattern check, not a verdict on the reviewer — it can't prove who wrote what.
Think of it as a pattern scan of the wording: it can't tell you who actually wrote a review.
Brief.scoreFeedsLine: Only real written reviews and the marketplace rating feed the score.
Brief.independenceLine: We read the buyer reviews, grouped what buyers kept saying, and weighed the good against the bad. We're independent — not affiliated with or endorsed by any brand.
Brief.footerLine: Analysis of real written buyer reviews and the marketplace rating.

complaintNotes.oneOff: No complaint repeats across buyers — these are one-off concerns, shown because they matter.
complaintNotes.repeated: These concerns came up across multiple buyers.
complaintNotes.isolated: Buyers raised isolated concerns{about} — each is weighed against the praise above, where it's noted.
complaintNotes.none: No buyer complaints in the reviews we read.

answer.neutralBuy: Buyers are mostly positive about this product.
